verdict.rationale: The lancedb/lancedb repository is Apache-2.0 licensed. The docs say its storage layer runs on local NVMe, EBS, EFS or any S3-compatible object store, and a community user reports embedding LanceDB directly in their own Electron app, which confirms it runs on user-controlled infrastructure. Missing for 10: explicit first-party self-hosting or deployment documentation, and clarity on whether Enterprise features (OAuth/API-key auth, compliance) are available when self-hosted versus only via the remote/enterprise offering.
